MiniMax M3.1 Flash is MiniMax’s next-generation Flash model, built for agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity. MiniMax calls it a “generational leap” over its predecessor.

An early version ran anonymously as “Space Bunny”, and MiniMax says it processed over 200 trillion tokens before the official launch.

What’s new in M3.1 Flash: [...] What’s new in M3.1 Flash:

 About 3x faster online inference than its predecessor, with more aggressive sparsity improving inference efficiency
 A 70% lower usage cost for agentic tasks
 Output at 200+ tokens per second in everyday use, with a median of 170+
 Stronger agentic, coding, computer use and cybersecurity performance

Some numbers:

 DeepSWE v1.1: 73.7%
 OSWorld V2: 61.7 and ALE: 29.6, which MiniMax says rank first among Chinese models
 BankerToolBench: 76.2
 CyberGym: 82%, assessed by MiniMax’s internal security experts

Pricing is flat at $0.15 per 1M input tokens, $0.60 per 1M output tokens and $0.015 per 1M cached input tokens.
